name: Ben Lin
bio: My work explores architectural and digital design, from interventions in the urban fabric to the interfaces of a building envelope. This portfolio presents two projects from 2026.

projects.title: Port City Vertical Park System
projects.description: How can a new urban system integrate into the existing fabric of a port city? This graduation project explores a vertical park system as an architectural intervention within the existing city.

images.caption: 01 / Aerial view — intervention within the existing urban fabric
02 / Street perspectives and elevated park spaces
03 / Section — street, building and elevated landscape

projects.title: Kaohsiung Airport Facade
projects.description: A collaborative detail design study of the interfaces between the entrance vestibule, curtain wall and canopy. My contribution focused on physical model making and photography, documenting the relationships between the facade elements.

images.caption: 01 / Front view — facade rhythm and entrance
02 / Model overview — curtain wall and canopy
